title: Balchem Reports Third Quarter 2026 Financial Results
summary: Balchem Corporation (NASDAQ: BCPC) reported today financial results for its 2026 fiscal third quarter ended September 30, 2026.
body_markdown:
Balchem Corporation reported financial results for its 2026 fiscal third quarter ended September 30, 2026. For the quarter, the Company reported net sales of $290.7 million, net earnings of $46.7 million, adjusted EBITDA(a) of $80.3 million, and free cash flow(a) of $57.9 million.


Ted Harris, Chairman, President and CEO of Balchem, said, “Balchem delivered another excellent quarter, with healthy growth across all three of our reporting segments and record consolidated quarterly net sales, net earnings, and adjusted EBITDA.”


**Third** **Quarter 2026 Financial Highlights:**


- Net sales were $290.7 million, an increase of 6% from the prior year quarter.
- GAAP net earnings were $46.7 million, an increase of 0% from the prior year quarter.
- Adjusted EBITDA was $80.3 million, an increase of 4% from the prior year quarter.
- GAAP earnings per share were $1.46 compared to $1.24 in the prior year quarter and adjusted earnings per share(a) were $1.57 compared to $1.35 in the prior year quarter.
- Cash flows from operations were $69.8 million, with free cash flow of $57.9 million.
- Sales and earnings from operations growth in all three of our reporting segments.


**Recent Highlights:**


- At the upcoming SupplySide Global trade show, we will showcase several of our latest Human Nutrition and Health technologies and innovations, including new science supporting VitaCholine®, K2VITAL™, Optifolin+® and OptiMSM®, as well as advances in performance nutrition and functional food and beverage applications. These innovations highlight the strength of our pipeline and our continued focus on developing differentiated, science-backed solutions that address important human health and wellness trends.
- Balchem repurchased approximately $28 million of common stock during the third quarter and approximately $127 million over the trailing twelve months, reflecting the Company’s balanced capital allocation strategy and commitment to long-term shareholder value creation.


**Quarterly Conference Call**


A quarterly conference call will be held on Friday, October 23, 2026, at 11:00 AM Eastern Time (ET) to review third quarter 2026 results. Ted Harris, Chairman, President and CEO and Martin Bengtsson, CFO, will host the call. Institutional investors, analysts and other members of the financial community are invited to join the live call by dialing +1-833-461-5787 (USA/Canada toll free) or +1-585-542-9983 (International Toll), and referencing Meeting ID: 831870284, five minutes prior to the scheduled start time of the conference call. The conference call will be available for replay shortly after the conclusion of the call at https://events.q4inc.com/attendee/831870284 for one year.


(a) See “Non-GAAP Financial Information” for a reconciliation of GAAP and non-GAAP financial measures.
